intro: Viewer Foundation gives optional THSV features one privacy-conscious identity and progression authority. It uses stable platform IDs, never guesses links from names, and stores no chat text.

sections.title: 1. Enable and link accounts
sections.description: Unlinked viewers still receive an installation-local pseudonymous ID. Add a link only when the creator has verified both stable platform IDs belong to the same person.

sections.title: 2. Everyday activity
sections.description: Chat points use a per-viewer cooldown so active conversation earns progress without rewarding spam.

sections.title: 3. Support and community events
sections.description: These are fixed event awards, not monetary conversions. StreamBridge never infers cash value from bits, gifts, or Jewels.

sections.title: 4. Levels
sections.description: Levels are deterministic: level = floor(points / points-per-level) + 1.

sections.title: 5. Privacy and storage limits
sections.description: Least-recently-seen records are removed at the viewer cap. Replay fingerprints expire automatically.
sections.notice: Private state contains one random installation salt, pseudonymous viewer IDs, point totals, levels, bounded award timestamps, and replay fingerprints. Raw platform IDs appear only in creator-authored account-link settings; they are never copied into runtime state.
